solutions.title: Enumerate and sort
solutions.strategy: Generate every pair, sort by sum, then take the first k pairs.

timeComplexity.explanation: All n times m pairs are sorted by sum.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Every candidate pair is stored before truncation.

solutions.title: Frontier min-heap
solutions.strategy: Seed the smallest pair from each nums1 prefix row, then advance one step in nums2 whenever a pair is popped.

timeComplexity.explanation: At most min(n,k) rows are seeded and each emitted pair performs one heap pop and maybe one push.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The heap stores one frontier pair per seeded nums1 index.
